name: yamlDeserializeFile
description: Reads a YAML file from disk and parses it into native CFML values (structs, arrays, numbers, booleans, strings and null).

params.name: filePath
params.description: Path to the YAML file to read and parse.

params.name: charset
params.description: Character encoding used to read the file (accepted for compatibility; files are read as UTF-8).

examples.title: Load a YAML file into a struct
examples.description: Reads and parses the YAML file in one call.
